release_notes.title: Memory, Notion and Blender fixes + new UltraGUI
release_notes.summary: Fixes memory notes that could not be pasted into, Notion startup freezes, plans that stopped without starting, false "Not connected" bars and Blender commands failing while busy. UltraGUI is replaced with the new GUI skill pack, and the desktop app gets an automatic-updates switch.
added: Memory: Paste button and import of .md, .json or .txt files, each saved as its own note.
Desktop app: Settings → Updates switch to turn automatic updates off (manual Update still works).
improved: UltraGUI replaced with the new 8-skill GUI pack, used only for ScreenGui, BillboardGui and SurfaceGui work, with fewer repeated checks.
Blender: a command waits for one that is already running instead of failing, and reconnects after a short drop.
Long messages sent as a file now describe themselves plainly.
fixed: Typing and pasting into memory notes works again.
One-time task reference no longer makes the AI think its command had not run.
Notion startup no longer freezes or stays unsent when preferences contain formatting.
Plans that end with "Shall I proceed?" continue in Plan Mode/Ultracode instead of stopping.
No more false "Not connected" bar in a running Notion chat.
If Notion does not take a screenshot, PlazCode sends the text once and points to the capture viewer.
Slow Blender answers no longer mark Blender as disconnected.
Notion: a tool result that landed in the chat but could not be matched no longer stops the turn with "Message was not confirmed".
notes: Automated regressions passed. Not yet tested live in Notion, Roblox Studio or Blender.

sections.title: 🧠 Memory
items: **Paste works:** typing and pasting into notes no longer gets swallowed.
**Import:** add .md, .json or .txt files as notes, as-is.

sections.title: 🛠️ Agent fixes
items: **Notion:** startup no longer freezes on formatted preferences; no false "Not connected" bar; screenshot fallback.
**Plans continue:** "Shall I proceed?" no longer stops Plan Mode/Ultracode.
**References:** task reference now comes after the real command result.
**Blender:** waits for a busy command and survives slow answers.
**Notion:** an accepted tool result is no longer reported as "Message was not confirmed".

sections.title: ✨ New
items: **UltraGUI:** new GUI skill pack, GUI-only and faster.
**Auto-update switch** in the desktop app.

sections.title: 🧪 Checks
items: Automated regressions passed. Not yet tested live in Notion, Studio or Blender.

release_notes.title: Notion startup send fix
release_notes.summary: Fixes Notion startup getting stuck with a half-written command list in the chat box, which then left every command as not run.
improved: If Notion stops accepting a long startup message part-way, PlazCode switches to sending it as a file straight away instead of waiting again.
fixed: Notion no longer leaves part of PlazCode's command list in the chat box with “Message was not confirmed” after Start Agent.
Commands no longer stay “not run” after that startup failure, because PlazCode clears its own leftover draft.
notes: Text you typed yourself is still never cleared.
Automated platform/browser regressions passed. This fix was not tested on a live Notion account.

sections.title: 🛠️ Notion startup fixed
items: **No half-written drafts:** if Notion stops accepting the long startup message, PlazCode clears its own leftover text and sends the full message as a file.
**Commands run again:** the leftover draft no longer blocks every later command.
**Less waiting:** after one stalled attempt, later long messages go straight to the file method.

sections.title: 🧪 Checks
items: Platform/browser regressions passed. Text you typed is never cleared. Not yet tested on a live Notion account.

release_notes.title: Notion Start Agent, plans and task checklist fixes
release_notes.summary: Start Agent works again in Notion AI, the AI keeps going after plans, and task checklists show real progress.
added: Task checklists build numbered steps from your request and the AI’s plan, with a goal header and “x of y done” progress.
improved: Each Notion chat thread is tracked separately, so new chats no longer reuse an older chat's session.
Large Notion startup messages are written safely without freezing the tab, with a chunked fallback for slow editors.
In Plan Mode and Ultracode, the AI is reminded once to start building after it writes a plan instead of stopping.
The command list tells the AI which addons, such as Blender, are connected.
The automatic prompt enhancer only runs before creation saves and never blocks the original command.
fixed: Notion Start Agent sends the startup command list automatically instead of leaving it in the chat box, including when Notion reformats it.
Notion's new /ai landing page and New chat button are recognised again.
Notion draft checks read emoji and smart quotes the way Notion displays them.
Sent Notion messages are recognised even when Notion changes spacing or formatting, so commands are no longer reported as not run.
PlazCode finds Notion's send button even when its label changes, and never overwrites text you typed yourself.
A short extra line after “PlazCode is ready.” no longer causes a startup handshake failure loop.
Skill and reference notes are sent once per task instead of replacing every command result.
Task checklists no longer stay at 0% or “Waiting for the AI…”.
notes: Start Agent was confirmed on a live Notion account (Windows, Chrome, AgentScript) before the plan, checklist and reformatted-draft fixes were added; those later fixes passed automated tests only.
Automated platform/browser regressions passed. Live Roblox Studio imports and the Blender addon connection were not re-tested.

sections.title: 🛠️ Notion Start Agent fixed
items: **Startup:** the command list sends itself instead of staying in the chat box, even when Notion reformats it.
**New Notion layout:** the /ai page, chat threads and New chat button are recognised again.
**Sends recognised:** emoji, curly quotes and formatting changes no longer make commands look unsent.
**Startup loop fixed:** a short extra line after “PlazCode is ready.” is accepted.

sections.title: 🧠 Plans and tasks
items: **Keeps going:** in Plan Mode and Ultracode the AI starts building after writing its plan.
**Working checklist:** numbered steps from your request and the AI’s plan, with progress.
**Clean results:** skill notes are sent once per task instead of replacing command results.

sections.title: ⚙️ Tools
items: **Addons:** the AI is told when Blender is connected.
**Prompt enhancer:** only runs before creation saves and never blocks a command.

sections.title: 🧪 Checks
items: Platform/browser regressions passed. Start Agent was confirmed on a live Notion account; the later fixes were tested automatically only.

release_notes.title: Reliable chats, simpler skills and Blender fixes
release_notes.summary: More reliable AI chats, simpler skills, complete tool results and a cleaner desktop.
added: Import Markdown skills and remove saved skills.
Ultracode uses relevant UltraGUI references for interface work.
Choose input and tool-result limits, or turn them off.
Enlarge screenshots with Copy and Use as feedback controls.
improved: Tasks show the AI’s objective and keep it when you say continue.
Desktop UI and model builders are removed. Ask your AI to build UI or use Blender for models.
Large tool results can be read in complete pages without repeating commands.
fixed: Notion startup checks survive editor redraws; DeepSeek uses a smaller first handshake.
Question fields accept typing; stopped operations release their input locks.
Stalled tool, file, web and stream waits have bounded exits.
Skills Save works in the initial editor and keeps its confirmation.
Blender primitives, export geometry and screenshot file reads are corrected.
One missed reply no longer falsely reports a disconnected Blender addon.
Settings header alignment, hidden task styling and the Ultracode label are corrected.
notes: Default task time limits are disabled; command deadlines remain active.
Automated platform/browser regressions and real Blender tests passed. Live signed-in AI chats, Studio imports and AI response latency were not verified.

sections.title: 🛠️ More reliable chats
items: **Startup and commands:** Notion draft checks and DeepSeek handshakes are improved. Stalled waits end safely without repeating commands.
**Answer boxes:** you can type responses to the AI’s questions.

sections.title: 🧩 Skills and Ultracode
items: **Simpler skills:** name, write and save; import JSON, text or Markdown; remove skills you no longer need.
**UltraGUI:** relevant UI guidance is included with Ultracode, loaded only when needed.

sections.title: 🎨 Cleaner desktop
items: **Builders removed:** ask your AI to make UI, or use Blender for models.
**Clearer tasks:** names describe the AI’s goal; continue keeps the plan. Spacing and Settings alignment are improved.
**Screenshots:** click to enlarge, copy or use as feedback. Unopened captures disappear after 10 seconds.

sections.title: ⚙️ Large scripts and Blender
items: **Complete results:** customize character limits and read large results in pages. Default task time limits are off.
**Blender fixes:** corrected primitives, detailed mesh exports and screenshot reads.

sections.title: 🧪 Checks
items: Platform/browser regressions and real Blender tests passed. Live AI chats, Studio imports and AI response speed were not verified.

release_notes.title: Quick replies, clear tasks and Notion fixes
release_notes.summary: Small requests stay brief, checklists follow your goals, and Notion handles results and connection status more reliably.
improved: Quick command lists use a shorter reference, without project setup.
Real work keeps its project guidance and original goals when you say continue.
fixed: Greetings, help and command lists no longer become tracked tasks.
Command names no longer become checklist steps.
Message timestamps no longer run into checklist labels.
Notion tool results stay in compact cards instead of showing raw source text.
Working Notion chats keep their connection status when messages are redrawn or hidden.
notes: Automated regressions cover startup, commands, Studio detection fixtures and updating. Live AI accounts, response speed and real Studio sessions were not tested.

sections.title: 💬 Quick replies for small requests
items: **Greetings stay simple:** hello, thanks, help and quick questions no longer start a project task or checklist.
**Faster command discovery:** asking to list commands skips project memory, skills, templates and checkpoint setup, and uses a shorter command reference.

sections.title: ✅ Tasks follow your goal
items: **Meaningful task names:** checklists describe what you want accomplished, rather than tool names such as list_commands. Old command-list entries no longer become the active checklist goal.
**Continue keeps the plan:** real work retains its original goal and project guidance when you ask to continue.

sections.title: 🎨 Cleaner checklist text
items: **Readable labels:** chat timestamps no longer get copied against the task name. Times written inside your instructions stay intact.

sections.title: 🛠️ Notion reliability
items: **Readable results:** tool results show as compact cards instead of raw source text.
**Accurate connection:** working chats stay connected when Notion redraws or hides older messages.

sections.title: 🧪 Regression checks
items: Automated checks cover quick requests, task retention, command schemas, startup, Studio detection fixtures, updating and Windows/Mac builds. Live AI accounts, response speed and real Studio sessions were not tested.
